fusions.name: Bog Buck
fusions.desc: Springs up from a crouch into a double hind kick that deals 16 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Splashdown
fusions.desc: Lands hard, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Reed Vault
fusions.desc: Springs you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Marsh Strider

riders.text: you cross it faster than dry ground
and you spring clear of whatever reaches for you there
and every kick lands before the splash settles

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground.
